svg.title: Contribution activity as an oscilloscope trace
svg.desc: Oscilloscope-style trace of weekly GitHub contributions over the last year (square-root scale). 1274 contributions, 181 active days out of 371, longest streak 70 days, current streak 0 days, peak day 120 on 2026-09-11, mean 24.0 per week.
